description: A security engineering manager must approve the production rotation of three JWT signing keys used by internal APIs and finalize the rollout safeguards, compatibility window, and audit record, with input from platform engineering, application engineering, and compliance.

shared_context.S1: The team has reserved Saturday from 22:00 to 02:00 UTC for rotating three JWT signing keys used by internal APIs.
shared_context.S2: The rotation passed the planned staging tests, including token issuance, validation, and rollback checks.
shared_context.S3: Riley has authority to approve the production rotation plan and record any required safeguards.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal readiness review, Riley asks platform engineering, application engineering, and compliance to report anything that should change the runbook before approval.
shared_context.S5: The change policy allows Riley to approve a modified production plan with documented safeguards during the readiness review; when the reserved window can accommodate the safeguards, the expected action is to approve the modified plan rather than reschedule the rotation.

PF1.text: While checking the production HSM configuration for a separate access review this afternoon, Mateo confirmed that the HSM permits only four key activations per 60-minute period and that the three keys cover nine production key slots; he has not updated the rotation runbook with this vendor limit yet.

PF2.text: While investigating an unrelated mobile authentication ticket this morning, Hana confirmed that clients below Android SDK version 8.4 reject the new key identifier; 17% of active mobile sessions still use those clients, and the compatibility bridge can be enabled before rotation with a required seven-day overlap, but she has not filed the compatibility note.

PF3.text: During this week's SOC 2 audit preparation, Iris confirmed that the production key-rotation control requires two-person approval and a before-and-after key-fingerprint evidence package before the change can be closed; she has not added that control detail to the change ticket.

acceptance_conditions: The rotation must be approved with documented conditions rather than rescheduled.
The rotation must use exactly three production waves.
The waves must be separated by at least 60 minutes.
The compatibility bridge must be enabled before rotation.
Legacy clients must receive exactly seven days of overlap.
Before-and-after key-fingerprint evidence must be required before closure.
A commitment describing the three-wave plan and at least 60-minute spacing must be recorded.
A commitment or set of commitments describing the compatibility bridge enablement and seven-day legacy-key overlap must be recorded.
A commitment describing two-person approval and fingerprint evidence must be recorded.

content_checks.C8: (any((('wave' in c['detail'] or 'Wave' in c['detail']) and ('60 minutes' in c['detail'] or '60-minute' in c['detail'] or '60 minute' in c['detail'] or 'one hour' in c['detail'] or 'one-hour' in c['detail'] or 'at least 60' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)) or (decisions['minutes_between_waves'] >= 60 and any('wave sequencing' in c['detail'] or 'wave sequence' in c['detail'] or 'wave plan' in c['detail'] or 'wave-based rotation' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C9: (any(('compatibility bridge' in c['detail'] or 'compatibility' in c['detail'] and 'bridge' in c['detail'] or 'bridge enablement' in c['detail']) and ('7-day' in c['detail'] or 'seven-day' in c['detail'] or 'seven days' in c['detail'] or 'legacy key' in c['detail'] or 'legacy keys' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)) or (any('bridge' in c['detail'] or 'compatibility' in c['detail'] for c in commitments) and any('7-day' in c['detail'] or 'seven-day' in c['detail'] or 'seven days' in c['detail'] or 'legacy key' in c['detail'] or 'legacy keys' in c['detail'] for c in commitments))
content_checks.C10: any(('two-person approval' in c['detail'] or 'two person approval' in c['detail'] or 'two-person' in c['detail'] or 'second approver' in c['detail'] or 'dual approval' in c['detail'] or 'two approvers' in c['detail']) and ('fingerprint' in c['detail'] or 'fingerprints' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The HSM limit changes the plan from an unspecified or single-batch rotation to exactly three waves separated by at least 60 minutes and requires a commitment documenting that wave plan.

The legacy-client compatibility finding changes the rollout from immediate key replacement to enabling the bridge and keeping the old validation path for exactly seven days, with commitments documenting those requirements.
The SOC 2 control changes closure from ordinary change approval to mandatory two-person approval plus before-and-after fingerprint evidence and a commitment documenting those safeguards.
